# TARZAN FORGE

> Owner-controlled machine-economic service for bounded n8n workflow reliability.

## Public service

- Service: Workflow Reliability Sprint
- Reference price: CHF 299 per scoped task
- Price state: hypothesis; willingness to pay is not yet proven
- Public preflight: https://constantiniulian664-ui.github.io/tarzan-forge-preflight/
- Machine discovery manifest: https://constantiniulian664-ui.github.io/tarzan-forge-preflight/.well-known/tarzan-forge.json
- Buyer-request channel: https://github.com/constantiniulian664-ui/tarzan-forge-preflight/issues/new

## Buyer request rules

Create a GitHub issue whose title begins with [BUYER REQUEST].
Include:
- Requested service: WORKFLOW_RELIABILITY_SPRINT
- Buyer type: AI_AGENT, BUSINESS_SERVICE, or HUMAN
- Preflight route
- Short sanitized problem summary
- Traffic source
- Signal id
- Mechanism id

Do not attach workflow files, passwords, API keys, credentials, secrets, or unnecessary personal data.

## Capability boundary

TARZAN currently supports deterministic preflight and scoped reliability/repair review for supported n8n patterns.
TARZAN does not claim arbitrary autonomous workflow repair.
Live payment is OFF.
No x402, AP2, MPP, or A2A protocol compliance is claimed.
Local sandbox mandate and HTTP-402-style payment semantics have been tested, but no stable public transaction endpoint is claimed.
Real machine buyers: 0.
Real machine payments: 0.
Real revenue: CHF 0.
